source: I-24 MOTION INCEPTION v1.x, 30 Nov 2022 westbound (6386d89efb3ff533c12df167__post10), mainline lanes 1-4, data x in [0, 5492) m, 06:00-10:00 CST, 900 s windows

parameters.q_cap_fd_source: fd.ci95.q_max[1] (coverage-limited tracked capacity; NOT a facility capacity)
parameters.q_cap_hcm_source: HCM 6th ed. basic freeway segment capacity at >= 70 mi/h FFS, pc/h/ln (upper envelope)

estimator_definitions.equilibrium: per lane rho_tracked(span) / rho_eq(v_edie; IDM mean params, L=5 m), density weighted; NaN in free flow
estimator_definitions.gap_moments: (1 - cv_obs^2)/(1 - cv_true^2) per speed class (cv_true from the mixture fit, spacings winsorized at s_max), spacing-count weighted
estimator_definitions.gap_mixture: MLE geometric-gamma mixture per speed class (< 60 km/h) on 2 s snapshot spacings over the span, spacing-count weighted
estimator_definitions.gap_mixture_coarse_classes: as gap_mixture with 10 km/h classes (class-width sensitivity)
estimator_definitions.gap_mixture_local: as gap_mixture on the ramp-free stretch [0, 900) m
estimator_definitions.capacity_bound_fd: crossings at x=200 m / (window * q_cap_fd), effective over lanes
estimator_definitions.capacity_bound_hcm: crossings at x=200 m / (window * q_cap_hcm), effective over lanes
estimator_definitions.capacity_bound_fd_span: Edie flow over the span / q_cap_fd
estimator_definitions.section_gap_mixture: gap_mixture_local * crossings / (window * q_local_edie): coverage of the crossing count at x=200 m
estimator_definitions.recommended: max(section_gap_mixture, capacity_bound_fd); NaN where the section estimate is undefined (free flow)
estimator_definitions.recommended_filled: recommended with undefined windows taking the nearest defined window's value (forward, then backward fill); recommended_is_filled marks them

recommendation.note: section_gap_mixture is the only estimator that (a) needs no car-following model, (b) applies to the crossing count that is the demand input, and (c) recovers a known coverage on synthetic lanes with a homogeneous spacing scale (see synthetic_validation); it is biased LOW where the true spacing scale is heterogeneous within a speed class and uninformative in free flow, so the FD capacity bound is applied as a floor. Windows outside the congested regime carry the bound only.
